guides.title: 矽光子頻率梳：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Silicon-photonic frequency combs: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 頻率梳的光譜線存在不代表相位鎖定。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Comb lines alone do not establish phase locking. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察光學平台和量測鏈的組織；不是某一課的同調接收器、光達或頻率梳實測。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：頻率梳的光譜線存在不代表相位鎖定。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：使用射頻拍頻與相干性證據輔助光譜。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe the organization of an optical bench and measurement chain; not a measured coherent receiver, lidar or frequency-comb dataset for this course.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Comb lines alone do not establish phase locking. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Add RF beat and coherence evidence to optical spectra. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「使用射頻拍頻與相干性證據輔助光譜」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Add RF beat and coherence evidence to optical spectra, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 矽光子頻率梳：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon-photonic frequency combs: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「矽與氮化矽：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。矽光子生態含不同材料；Si 與 SiN 的吸收、非線性與熱限制不能混用。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Silicon versus silicon nitride: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. The silicon-photonics ecosystem includes distinct materials; Si and SiN absorption, nonlinearity and thermal limits are not interchangeable. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜矽與氮化矽：模型與設計：建立兩材料在選定波段的非線性與損失表，未知值不猜填。
觀察站 2｜泵浦失諧：模型與設計：比較正反向掃描的透射、梳功率與射頻雜訊。
觀察站 3｜應用驗收：量測與判別：為一個選定用途列最差梳齒驗收，不以總頻寬取代全部指標。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Silicon versus silicon nitride: model and design: Build material tables for the chosen band and leave unmeasured values unresolved.
Observation station 2 | Pump detuning: model and design: Compare transmission, comb power and RF noise on forward/reverse scans.
Observation station 3 | Application acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Define worst-line acceptance for one application rather than replacing all metrics with total span.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「泵浦失諧：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「應用驗收：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Pump detuning: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Application acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：等間距光譜即可證明全部梳齒相干。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：等間距光譜即可證明全部梳齒相干。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Equally spaced spectra alone prove full comb coherence. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

history.textEn: Nature Communications / research authors: Microresonator dispersion engineering and frequency combs provides a traceable development example.
